anthropic.support_note: First-party Anthropic models routed through the locally managed CLIProxyAPI OAuth gateway; this transport path is not officially supported by Anthropic.

deepseek.support_note: DeepSeek Anthropic endpoint (Flash probes 2026-08-12; Pro GA docs/live route 2026-08-19): x-api-key, 1M, thinking default-on. Tools work in Flash probes/docs; Pro tool acceptance is unverified because Pro max thinking rejected a named forced tool_choice. Omit tool_choice and let the model select offered tools. Text-only; cache_control ignored; server MCP blocks unsupported. Listing: Bearer OpenAI-shape GET /models (Anthropic path 404). China-based, no region pinning.

kimi.support_note: Third-party Claude-compatible route through the local gateway; locally validated experimental transport, not officially supported by Anthropic.

openai.support_note: Third-party Codex route through the local OAuth gateway; locally validated experimental transport, not officially supported by Anthropic or OpenAI.

openrouter.support_note: OpenRouter's Anthropic skin (aggregator; no prompt logging by default, no training-provider routing unless opted in). Only guaranteed by OpenRouter for Anthropic first-party models; Grok 4.6 exact-slug tool/stream/xhigh behavior requires a fresh acceptance call. Listing: public OpenAI-shape GET /api/v1/models (no key). The moving alias ~x-ai/grok-latest currently resolves 4.6 but is not a trusted wire: D3 forbids hidden moving authority outside record+catalog.

qwen.support_note: Third-party Claude-compatible route through the local gateway; locally validated experimental transport, not officially supported by Anthropic or Alibaba.
